solver_notes: Native Linux C11 epoll/pthreads regression model executed on physical aarch64 Cortex-A72; this is not a claimed crossbeam-rs patch (the supplied metadata pairs a Rust repository with a Linux C target). Four accept threads register one nonblocking SO_REUSEPORT loopback listener in independent epoll sets. The fixed mode adds EPOLLEXCLUSIVE at EPOLL_CTL_ADD. A real kernel reallocation probe proves EPOLL_CTL_MOD cannot add EPOLLEXCLUSIVE (EINVAL) and that DEL+ADD with EPOLLEXCLUSIVE succeeds. Accepted descriptors are distributed through a bounded Vyukov-style MPMC queue using only C11 size_t atomics (atomic_is_lock_free=YES), with four consumers reading and closing every real socket. The initial legacy run measured 237 empty EAGAIN wakeups versus 1 with EPOLLEXCLUSIVE; subsequent runs report measured values without assuming a herd on every schedule. Five repeated native runs, UBSan, and both declared pytest compatibility paths pass. No claim of upstream crossbeam validation is made.
